messages:
rachel: Quick follow-up from today's fairness sync. We debated delegated budgets vs sticky affinity. Posting outcome + minimal API sketch.

omar: tl;dr? what did we land on?

rachel: Hybrid: delegated burst budgets at edge for latency, plus lightweight cross-edge detection (bloom summaries) for stateless traffic. Sticky affinity for sessions.

kevin: delegation heuristics: default burst 5 tokens, refill 1 token/sec. Overdraw triggers soft-throttle first; only hard revoke on repeated high-confidence overdraws.

li: bloom summaries: edges periodically publish compact per-tenant counters to a global pipeline. If bloom indicates cross-edge spike, escalate to global adjudicator. Keep summaries ~5s rollup to limit noise.

omar: API: POST /v1/delegate/claim -> {granted, budget_left, mode}. Modes: NORMAL, DEGRADED, FAILFAST. FAILFAST -> immediate reject with 503.

kevin: security: use short-lived signed vouchers for delegation claims. Edge presents voucher to shard; shard validates sig & ttl. Rotate signer keys monthly.

rachel: revokes: reconciler emits revoke events with reason_code and confidence. Admission must surface transparent headers to clients when soft-throttled or revoked. No silent drops.

li: telemetry: delegated_grants, overdraws, reconciles, cross_edge_alerts. Alert if >0.5% hard revokes post-accept.

omar: rollout plan: lab sim, 5% canary with synthetic multi-edge abusers, expand to 25% once metrics stable. Docs + rollback playbook required.

kevin: one more: tenant opt-in flags: "strong-affinity" for enterprise (higher latency but strict fairness) and "aggressive-burst" for low-latency workloads (smaller revocation tolerance).

rachel: Decision summary: adopt HYBRID delegated-budget model with conservative defaults (5 tokens, 1s refill), bloom summaries for cross-edge detection, sticky affinity for sessions, signed vouchers, and soft-first revoke behavior. Ops-run canary in 10m.

ops-bot: scheduled: delegate-hybrid/canary queued in 10m. :hourglass:

li: I'll draft the proto and the bloom schema. kevin -> voucher signer rotation plan, omar -> reconciler + revoke audit trail, rachel -> rollout doc.

omar: no objections from me.

rachel: thanks all, will post RFC addendum and link the proto PR after the canary starts.
